Remark
[Relative curvature scale] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0256 1. Equation 8.13\group dilations-of-finite-time-singularities

The relative curvature scale of a point $x$ at time $t$ is the ratio \[ \frac{|\Rm (x,t)|}{\sup _{\mathcal M^n}|\Rm (\cdot ,t)|}. \]
